dataset_title: Practice guide 40: supplement 4 — boundary agreements and determined boundaries

field_evidence.general_boundary_rule: Unless determined under section 60 of the Land Registration Act 2002, the boundary of a registered estate shown for the register is a general boundary.
field_evidence.determined_boundary_semantics: A determined boundary shows the exact line of the boundary of a registered estate.
field_evidence.target_specific_evidence_requirement: The registrar must be satisfied that the plan, or plan and verbal description, identifies the exact line claimed and that the applicant has an arguable case for that exact line.
field_evidence.plan_requirement: The supporting plan must clearly show the extent, start/end/turning points, sufficient surrounding detail and a stated scale.
field_evidence.canonical_extent_limitation: Without a target-specific determined-boundary register entry and supporting plan, this source cannot establish an exact canonical parcel geometry/bbox.
